checks.ex_quotient_base:
Closes under DEC-52 and DEC-47.
(i) quotientBase_ruled is a real composition of quotientBase, quotientBase_sing_subset and cylHomeomorph. It gives the unique maximal a.e. structure with the projection an a.e. morphism, (support B)ᶜ ⊆ π{r=0} (DEC-52's sing(M) ⊆ π{r=0}), and M ≃ₜ ℂ × Z. Its hypotheses are the paper's: D a local homeomorphism on {r>0}, Γ_α acting by a.e. morphisms (stated as an assumption by the paper itself), α ≠ 0 (weaker than α > 0). The (G,X) hypotheses are weaker than DEC-39's analytical structure.
(ii) The singular-manifold topology (T2, locally connected, second countable when Z is) is quotientBase_topology. sing(M̃) ⊆ {r=0} is subset_support_devStructure. Both are listed in the row's decls.
(iii) misner_variations_ruled is misner_isom0_general at its second disjunct. Its hypothesis is DEC-52's word for word: ∀ w ≠ 0, nullQ w = 0 → nullB w u = 0 → nullB v w ≠ 0, where nullB is the polarization of nullQ (nullQ_add, nullB_self) and nullQ = c² − ab is Q(t,x,y) = x² + y² − t² in null coordinates. The hypothesis can be satisfied by a spacelike v: for u = (0,0,1) take v = (1,1,2), Q(v) = 3 > 0, nullB v w ≠ 0 on both null lines of u^⊥. nullB_ne_zero_of_timelike (reverse Cauchy-Schwarz) is a real proof and shows that every timelike v qualifies. The IsLocalHomeomorphOn conjunct rules out a degenerate (θ-independent) boostConj.
(iv) DEC-47's developing maps (massive_particle_intended, btz_blackhole_past_isom0, btz_whitehole_isom0) are unchanged from the WP-26b rounds the earlier audits found clean.
(v) Tachyons and photons (l.682) and polyhedral gluings (l.684): SCOPE (c) states precisely why they are informal. The paper gives no developing map, no G, and no choice of lift to the universal cover of RP^1; the lift decides whether the action on {r>0} is free at all, and the claim about which lifts act freely is correct (the lift fixing a lift of a fixed point has displacement below one period, so composing it with a non-zero deck translation acts freely). 'Tachyon' and 'photon' are undefined, and no polyhedra are given. This is what the dispatch asked for.
checks.ex_consider_identifying: Closes under DEC-54(a). quotient_finite_model_analytical covers every finite Subgroup Γ of G that acts freely on a portly U ⊆ X, with X locally connected and T2 and the action rigid and ContinuousConstSMul. That is weaker than DEC-39's analytical structure, so the statement is stronger than the ruling asks. It concludes with the unique maximal a.e. structure on Γ\X with orbitMk an a.e. morphism from X's maximal atlas, plus Γ\X T2 and locally connected. finiteQuotient_of_t2 proves the same for any Hausdorff, locally connected (G,X)-manifold M acted on by (G,X)-morphisms. IsProperlyDiscontinuous.of_finite (T2, finite Γ, both halves of the reading) is a real proof, so the local compactness that quotient_finite_model assumed is gone. The other parts of the row (Isom⁺(𝔼^n), every order-p Γ ≤ Stab(S), the point-wise stabilizer ≅ SO(2), the metric isomorphism with 𝔼^n_{2π/p}, and the S^n/H^n variations) are unchanged and were found clean by the WP-26b audits.
